meta.name: organic-chemistry
meta.description: Carbon chemistry, functional groups, IUPAC nomenclature, isomerism, reaction mechanisms (substitution, elimination, addition), polymers, and biochemistry basics. Covers hydrocarbon classes (alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatics), common functional groups (alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, esters, amines, amides), stereochemistry, condensation and addition polymerization, and the four biomolecule classes (carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, nucleic acids). Use when analyzing organic structures, predicting reaction products, or connecting chemistry to biology.
